final: SELECT t.team_id, t.avg_win_rate, t.record_count, t.avg_win_rate - o.mean_avg AS diff FROM (SELECT team_id, AVG(CASE WHEN g > 0 THEN CAST(w AS REAL) / g END) AS avg_win_rate, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM manager_half GROUP BY team_id) t CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(avg_win_rate) AS mean_avg FROM (SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN g > 0 THEN CAST(w AS REAL) / g END) AS avg_win_rate FROM manager_half GROUP BY team_id)) o WHERE o.mean_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (t.avg_win_rate - o.mean_avg) IS NULL, (t.avg_win_rate - o.mean_avg) DESC LIMIT 10
